```artifact
Feature: Alarms - U07

  Background:
    Given the ventilator is initialized
    And the GUI is displayed

  Scenario: Medium Severity Alarm - Visual Indication [RW-SW-75]
    Given a medium severity alarm is triggered
    Then the alarm indicator color is yellow
    And the alarm indicator flashing frequency is 0.5 Hz
    And the alarm indicator duty cycle is 50%

  Scenario: High Severity Alarm - Auditory Signal - 10 Pulses [RW-SW-76]
    Given a high severity alarm is triggered
    Then an auditory signal is emitted
    And the auditory signal consists of 10 pulses
    And each pulse duration is 200ms
    And the pulse frequency is 500Hz (A4 note)

  Scenario: High Severity Alarm - Auditory Signal - 4 Pulses [RW-SW-77]
    Given a high severity alarm is triggered
    Then an auditory signal is emitted
    And the auditory signal consists of 4 pulses
    And each pulse duration is 200ms
    And the pulse frequency is 500Hz

  Scenario: Audio Pause / Alarm Pause - Functionality [RW-SW-78]
    Given multiple alarms are active
    When the AUDIO PAUSE / ALARM PAUSE key is pressed
    Then all active alarms are paused for 60 seconds
    And the alarm activation symbol IEC 60417-5576 is displayed

  Scenario Outline: Apnea Alarm - Triggering [RW-SW-80]
    Given the apnea time interval is <apnea_time> seconds
    When no breath is triggered within the apnea time interval
    Then a medium priority alarm is triggered
    And the display text is "APNEA ALARM"

    Examples:
      | apnea_time |
      | 5          |
      | 10         |
      | 15         |
      | 0          | # Boundary - immediate trigger
      | 60         |

  Scenario Outline: Breath Rate Alarm - Triggering [RW-SW-82]
    Given the breath rate setting is <breath_rate_setting> breaths per minute
    When the breath rate exceeds <breath_rate_setting> breaths per minute
    Then a medium level alarm is triggered
    And the display text is "HIGH BREATH RATE"

    Examples:
      | breath_rate_setting |
      | 12                  |
      | 20                  |
      | 30                  |
      | 1                  | # Boundary - very low setting
      | 60                  |

  Scenario: Breath Rate Alarm - Maximum Setting [RW-SW-83]
    Given a maximum breath rate setting is configured
    When the breath rate exceeds the maximum breath rate setting
    Then a medium level alarm is triggered

  Scenario: Low Pressure Alarm - Triggering [RW-SW-84]
    Given a low pressure condition is detected
    Then a high severity alarm is triggered
    And the auditory signal is emitted
    And the display text is "LOW INSP P"
```
